title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
abstract: DreamerV3 learns an environment model and improves behavior through imagined futures, using one configuration across more than 150 diverse control tasks.

title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
abstract: Flamingo bridges pretrained vision and language models, handles interleaved visual and textual sequences, and adapts to image and video tasks through in-context few-shot prompting.

title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
abstract: AgentBench evaluates language models as agents across eight interactive environments, measuring reasoning, decision making, instruction following, and long-horizon failures.
